notes: ACCESS: every www.qvc.com HTML listing page is still behind Akamai Bot Manager and returned HTTP 418 to direct fetch, WebFetch, r.jina.ai (Cloudflare-challenged) and translate.goog (origin 418 reached even via Google's IP) - the same hard block the prior Home-Decor pass recorded, so no rendered 'N items' header was obtainable for any node. robots.txt was checked first: it names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive. TREE: taken from QVC's own unblocked XML nav sitemaps (sitemap-us-index.xml -> sitemap-us-navigation-for-the-home.xml, -garden-and-outdoor-living.xml, -kitchen-and-food.xml, all HTTP 200), which publish the canonical /c/<path>/-/<groupId>/c.html URLs used verbatim in every 'link'. Cross-checked against the live Category facet returned by the search API for groupIds lglu (For the Home), gq7tw6 (Garden & Outdoor Living), lglv (Kitchen & Food), oioy (Furniture) and 14tqxpw (Patio). QVC's Furniture department (For the Home > Furniture, groupId oioy, 2537 products) has exactly 11 children and NO third level - querying each child returns an empty Category facet, so those children are the deepest real nodes. COUNTS: from the unblocked internal JSON API api.qvc.com/api/product/v5/us/search, which refuses an absent/empty searchTerm (an empty term returns only a 'features' stub). Method per node: sweep a battery of ~17 terms against the node's groupId and accept only a PLATEAU - the maximum value, reached independently by 3-6 different terms, with every term-specific query strictly below it. This was validated, not assumed: for Seating the 'the' and 'home' result sets were fully enumerated (943 product IDs each) and were identical; and every accepted child total equals the value the parent node's own Category facet reports for that child. The prior pass's assumption that the/for/home are always pass-through is WRONG on some nodes and was caught here: on Patio and Outdoor Furniture those three terms return 1213/1218/1345 and 194/198/316 while 'and', 'outdoor', 'patio' and 'furniture' all converge on 2537 and 1260, and a term-specific query (chair=296) exceeds the stopword result - proving the stopwords under-return there. Discrimination checks confirm the group filter is genuinely applied (searchTerm=lipstick returns 0 in every furniture node; searchTerm=rug returns 0 inside Outdoor Furniture, so the sibling Outdoor Rugs node of 965 is not bleeding into it). Every accepted count was read twice; all 13 were stable. EXCLUDED and why: Furniture > Slipcovers (23) and Furniture > Accessories (9 - furniture sliders, seat sliders, room dividers) as furniture covers and parts; For the Home > Mattresses (389) as bedding per the brief; For the Home > Home Projects & Tools > Shelving & Storage (93) because QVC does not file it under Furniture and a tile scan is predominantly wire utility racks, storage cubes, bins and collapsible boxes; Kitchen & Food > Storage & Organization > Kitchen Islands (groupId 1ckux) and Kitchen Carts (uctz36), which would have been in scope but both return zero products and no longer appear in the live Category facet of their parent; laundry drying racks, step stools & ladders, utility carts, pet beds & houses, Garden > Outdoor Decor, Patio > Outdoor Rugs / Outdoor Lighting / Grills / Fire Pits, and all lighting, mirrors, rugs, bedding, decorative-accent and standalone-storage nodes. LINK CAVEAT: because every category page returns 418 the URLs could not be opened; they are QVC's own canonical sitemap URLs. Outdoor Furniture is the single link assembled rather than copied - the nav sitemap publishes only its cross-listed variant '.../patio/outdoor-furniture/storage-and-organization/-/b3jrmp-qd3ump/c.html', which fixes both the path segments and the groupId, so the plain form was built from QVC's invariant /c/<path>/-/<groupId>/c.html pattern.
